title: The Woman Who Never Lets You Finish A Thought
description:
What happens when you try to finish a thought… and I simply refuse to let you?

In this session, your mind becomes the playground.

Every thought you try to hold, I interrupt. Every idea you reach for, I crowd out. Every little attempt to think ahead gives me another opportunity to step in and finish it for you.

At first, it feels like a game.

Try to hold onto one thought while listening to my voice. Keep it clear. Keep it yours.

Then notice how quickly the edges begin to blur.

Because the longer you listen, the less room there seems to be for anything except me.

The Woman Who Never Lets You Finish a Thoughtis an 18–20 minute hypnosis experience built around mental interruption, thought replacement, and the delicious relief of no longer needing to keep up with your own busy mind.

And while you’re under, I’ll be taking notes.

After all, every experiment needs a record of what happens to its subjects.

By the time you come back up, you may discover something rather interesting:

You didn’t lose your train of thought.

I took it.

Press play and try to hold onto a thought.

Let’s see which one of us finishes it.
author: Mistress Amethyst
